currentGenerationState.source: independently derived in this step from the WHOLE committed adjudication chain, not from the last record and not from the owner task text. Every committed A2 record carrying a per-slot acquisition verdict was parsed, its verdicts applied to a 110-entry status map in recordedAtUtc order, and each class counted element by element. Heterogeneous verdict fields were handled explicitly and an unclassifiable verdict would have ABORTED the derivation rather than been skipped. The ledger was read and validated with the landed harness (valid, 22 entries) and both Q1 occupants derived with currentOccupantForSelectionIndex

selectedOption.derivation: STEP 1-6 of the carried-forward DETERMINATE_Q1_REPLACEMENTS_BEFORE_NEW_PRIMARIES algorithm. Two determinate obligations exist, so they take positions 1 and 2 in ascending selectionIndex order; the remaining three positions are filled with the next never-started primaries in ascending order from 65, skipping nothing
selectedOption.whyThreePrimariesRatherThanFewer: the window size is exactly 5 whenever at least five executable work items remain, and 2 obligations plus 45 never-started primaries leaves far more than five
selectedOption.eachPrimarySlotWasCheckedUnreplaced: currentOccupantForSelectionIndex was evaluated for 65, 66 and 67; every one is ORIGINAL_SELECTION, so none has been replaced and none is a disguised repeat
selectedOption.neitherReplacementSlotHasBeenReplacedBef: slots 63 and 64 are both on their ORIGINAL selection. Reserve 22 and reserve 23 are each the FIRST replacement their slot has ever had

negativeProbes.purpose: each probe constructs a WRONG strategy variant and requires either the landed adapter or the independent current-state governance check to REFUSE it. Adapter acceptance alone is never sufficient authority

twoLayerModel.layer1: the landed windowSpecFromAcquisitionWindowStrategy adapter - structure, digests, splits, reserve ordering, ledger binding, and internal consistency with the strategy's OWN declared state
twoLayerModel.layer2: an INDEPENDENT current-state governance check, run here, that compares every replacement selectionIndex against the independently derived pending-obligation set and every primary against the independently derived NEVER_STARTED set
twoLayerModel.whyLayer2Exists: the adapter has no access to acquisition outcomes, so it cannot tell whether the state a strategy DECLARES is the state that actually holds. Layer 2 is the only layer that can

knownAdapterLimitations.noAcquisitionOutcomeAccess: proved by probe 7 with every digest correct. The adapter is internally consistent with whatever state a strategy DECLARES and cannot check that declaration against reality. Defence: layer 2, run here and again at every later planning point
knownAdapterLimitations.forgedSuccessCount: proved by probe 9. The adapter checks the success count only through P6 consistency, and at a 22-entry ledger P6 is NOT_TRIGGERED for any value at or above 50, so a forged value above the floor passes. Defence: layer 2 compares the declared count with the independently derived 62
knownAdapterLimitations.spentStrategyReplay: probe 8 refused here only because Window 04 binds the twenty-one-entry ledger revision. The adapter WOULD accept a spent strategy replayed against a ledger revision that still matches its own binding, because the ledger records no acquisition success. That general defence is procedural plus layer 2
